svg.title: RPO looks backward; RTO looks forward
svg.desc: An illustrative recovery timeline. Recovery point objective bounds the acceptable data-loss window before an outage; recovery time objective bounds the time to restore service after the outage. Five and thirty minutes are independent examples, not WAF defaults.
